# spokes-api/merges/v1/merges_api.proto



## Services

<a name="github.spokes.merges.v1.MergesAPI"></a>

### MergesAPI

MergesAPI contains APIs for merge-related Git operations.

<a name="github.spokes.merges.v1.MergesAPI-FindMergeBases"></a>

#### FindMergeBases

FindMergeBases computes one or all of the merge bases between two commits
using a specified algorithm.

##### Dev URL

`http://127.0.0.1:8081/twirp/github.spokes.merges.v1.MergesAPI/FindMergeBases`

<a name="github.spokes.merges.v1.FindMergeBasesRequest"></a>

##### FindMergeBasesRequest




| Field | Type | Label | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| repository | [github.spokes.types.v1.Repository](../../types/v1/repository.md#github.spokes.types.v1.Repository) |  | repository is the repository to operate on. |
| request_context | [github.spokes.types.v1.RequestContext](../../types/v1/request_context.md#github.spokes.types.v1.RequestContext) |  |  |
| base_oid | [github.spokes.types.v1.ObjectID](../../types/v1/object_id.md#github.spokes.types.v1.ObjectID) |  | base_oid is the base object ID to operate on. |
| (oneof head_oid) head_object_id | [github.spokes.types.v1.ObjectID](../../types/v1/object_id.md#github.spokes.types.v1.ObjectID) |  |  |
| (oneof head_oid) repo_head_object_id | [github.spokes.types.selectors.v1.RepoObjectIDSelector](../../types/selectors/v1/repo_object_id_selector.md#github.spokes.types.selectors.v1.RepoObjectIDSelector) |  |  |
| merge_base_type | [MergeBaseType](merge_base_type.md#github.spokes.merges.v1.MergeBaseType) |  | merge_base_type is the type of merge base computation to perform. |



<a name="github.spokes.merges.v1.FindMergeBasesResponse"></a>

##### FindMergeBasesResponse




| Field | Type | Label | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| bases | [github.spokes.types.v1.ObjectID](../../types/v1/object_id.md#github.spokes.types.v1.ObjectID) | repeated | bases are the resultant bases. |



<a name="github.spokes.merges.v1.MergesAPI-MergeTrees"></a>

#### MergeTrees

MergeTrees merges two treeish heads and returns either the merged tree
OID or a list of conflicts generated by the merge. Rename detection is
disabled by default.

##### Dev URL

`http://127.0.0.1:8081/twirp/github.spokes.merges.v1.MergesAPI/MergeTrees`

<a name="github.spokes.merges.v1.MergeTreesRequest"></a>

##### MergeTreesRequest




| Field | Type | Label | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| repository | [github.spokes.types.v1.Repository](../../types/v1/repository.md#github.spokes.types.v1.Repository) |  | repository is the repository to operate on. |
| request_context | [github.spokes.types.v1.RequestContext](../../types/v1/request_context.md#github.spokes.types.v1.RequestContext) |  |  |
| base_selector | [github.spokes.types.selectors.v1.MergeObjectSelector](../../types/selectors/v1/merge_object_selector.md#github.spokes.types.selectors.v1.MergeObjectSelector) |  | base_selector is which treeish to use for the left side of the merge. |
| head_selector | [github.spokes.types.selectors.v1.MergeObjectSelector](../../types/selectors/v1/merge_object_selector.md#github.spokes.types.selectors.v1.MergeObjectSelector) |  | head_selector is which treeish to use for the right side of the merge. |
| (oneof merge_base) merge_base_selector | [github.spokes.types.selectors.v1.MergeObjectSelector](../../types/selectors/v1/merge_object_selector.md#github.spokes.types.selectors.v1.MergeObjectSelector) |  | merge_base_selector is a selector for picking a merge base treeish. |
| (oneof merge_base) merge_base_none | [github.spokes.types.selectors.v1.NoneSelector](../../types/selectors/v1/none_selector.md#github.spokes.types.selectors.v1.NoneSelector) |  | merge_base_none represents an unspecified merge base, indicating that one should be computed as part of the merge. |
| options | [MergeTreesRequest.MergeTreesOptions](#github.spokes.merges.v1.MergeTreesRequest.MergeTreesOptions) |  | options is the set of options used to customize the behavior of the merge. If unspecified, all values use their default behavior. |
| resolutions | [MergeConflict.TreeEntry](merge_conflict.md#github.spokes.merges.v1.MergeConflict.TreeEntry) | repeated | (Optional) resolutions is a list of merge conflict resolutions that determine how conflicts at particular paths should be resolved. During a conflict, the path will be replaced with content referenced by the provided blob OID. |



<a name="github.spokes.merges.v1.MergeTreesResponse"></a>

##### MergeTreesResponse




| Field | Type | Label | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| transaction_context | [github.spokes.types.v1.TransactionContext](../../types/v1/transaction_context.md#github.spokes.types.v1.TransactionContext) |  | transaction_context contains the updated state after performing the write. |
| merge_status | [MergeTreesResponse.Status](#github.spokes.merges.v1.MergeTreesResponse.Status) |  | merge_status indicates the status of the merge operation. |
| (oneof result) oid | [github.spokes.types.v1.ObjectID](../../types/v1/object_id.md#github.spokes.types.v1.ObjectID) |  | oid is the object ID of the merged tree if the merge was successful. Note that we return the OID of the successful merge in a "mergeability only" request, but that OID is *not* persisted in the repository and should be used for client-side auditing purposes only. |
| (oneof result) conflicts | [MergeTreesResponse.MergeConflictResult](#github.spokes.merges.v1.MergeTreesResponse.MergeConflictResult) |  | conflicts represents the merge conflicts, if any, that prevented the merge from succeeding. Limited to 500 entries, only included when `include_conflict_details` is enabled. |
| (oneof result) none | [google.protobuf.Empty](https://developers.google.com/protocol-buffers/docs/reference/google.protobuf#google.protobuf.Empty) |  | none represents an intentionally empty result (e.g., due to an "already merged" status). |

### MergeTreesResponse.Status


| Name | Number | Description |
| ---- | ------ | ----------- |
| STATUS_INVALID | 0 |  |
| STATUS_SUCCESS | 1 |  |
| STATUS_MERGE_CONFLICT | 2 |  |
| STATUS_ALREADY_MERGED | 3 |  |
